## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant tests passed, or the reason they could not run is explained.
- [ ] Documentation and privacy behavior were updated where needed.
- [ ] New or changed dependencies and assets have compatible licenses and notices.
- [ ] Each contributed commit has a DCO `Signed-off-by:` trailer.
- [ ] Relevant platform validation is described; CI validation is not personal testing.
